title: Unit and component tests with Vitest and Jest

videos.script:
Every total the planner has shown you so far was wrong. {{red}} Today you find out by writing its first tests.

The tool is Vitest. {{vitest}} It runs on Vite, so it reads TypeScript the way your app does, and there is nothing to configure. A test calls a function with values you chose, and compares the answer with the one you worked out by hand.

The first test of the week is red. {{zone}} The cause is a time zone. A date with no time is midnight in London, and in São Paulo that is still yesterday evening. The fix is one idea: do all of the arithmetic in one zone.

Then the page. {{jsdom}} jsdom is a document without a screen. Your test fills in the form, submits it, and reads the new total. No browser starts.

Two stand-ins come next. {{mocks}} A function that records how it was called, and a clock the test can stop.

Last, the same tests in Jest, {{jest}} the runner you will meet in older projects. And coverage, {{coverage}} which says what ran, and never whether anything checked it.
